summary: A performance firmware that plays complete grooves in ten styles, from filter house and robot pop to disco and funk, steered with four knobs for filter sweep, sidechain pump, robot voice and energy.
features: Ten styles in two sets, CHROME and SESSION
ALGORITHM generates another song in the same style
ARC mode shapes intro, build, drop, solo and breakdown
Drop and solo buttons; play the lead live on the keys
Four parts with ten sounds each; formant robot voice; synthesized drums
MIDI out per part; uses Felucca's first two song slots
